response.sql: WITH customer_totals AS (SELECT c.CustomerId, COALESCE(SUM(i.Total), 0) AS total_spent FROM Customer AS c LEFT JOIN Invoice AS i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId), customer_shares AS (SELECT CustomerId, total_spent, total_spent * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(total_spent) FROM customer_totals) AS share FROM customer_totals), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS share FROM customer_shares) SELECT AVG(cs.total_spent) AS average_total_spent, AVG(cs.share) AS average_share, AVG(cs.share - a.share) AS average_share_difference FROM customer_shares AS cs CROSS JOIN average_share AS a WHERE cs.share > a.share;
